# Vendored browser dependency

PDF.js is self-hosted so the production page does not execute mutable code from a third-party CDN.

- Package: Mozilla PDF.js 4.10.38
- Source: `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/4.10.38/`
- License: Apache-2.0 (the complete notice is retained inside both files)
